narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Eight times five is eighty, because the groups are the same eight.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But each group of five has only half the dots of a group of ten.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>The total must be half of eighty, so the slip is struck out.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Five is half of ten, so times five is times ten and then halve.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Halving first works as well, and it is often quicker.
